## TC-FAN-3.1 Mandatory functionality with DUT as Server

## Purpose

This test case verifies the mandatory functionality of the Fan Control Cluster server.

## PICS

- FAN.S

## Required Devices

| Device Name | Device Description |

| 1 | TH | TH as Client. |
| 2 | DUT | DUT as Server. |

## Device Topology

TH and DUT are on the same fabric.

## Test Setup

Commission DUT to TH (can be skipped if done in a preceding test).

## Test Procedure

| # | Ref | PICS | Test Step | Expected Outcome |
| 1 | | | Commission DUT to TH | |
| 4 | | | TH tests the following scenario: • Attribute to update: PercentSetting • Attribute to verify: PercentSetting, FanMode and SpeedSetting (if present) • Update order: Ascending Actions: • Initialize the DUT to FanMode Off and read back the value to verify written value. • Individually subscribe to the PercentSetting , FanMode , and SpeedSetting (if supported) attributes • Update the value of the PercentSetting attribute iteratively, in ascending order, from 1 to 100. | For each update, the DUT shall return either a SUCCESS or an INVALID_IN_STATE status code. After all updates have been performed, verify that the value of the attribute reports from the subscription of each attribute came in sequentially in ascending order (each new value greater than the previous one). |

| 6 | TH tests the following scenario: • Attribute to update: FanMode • Attribute to verify: FanMode, PercentSetting and SpeedSetting (if present) • Update order: Ascending Actions: • Initialize the DUT to FanMode Off and read back the value to verify written value • Individually subscribe to the PercentSetting , FanMode , and SpeedSetting (if supported) attributes • Update the value of the FanMode attribute iteratively, in ascending order, from 0 (Off) to the number of available fan modes specified by the FanModeSequence attribute, excluding modes beyond 3 (High) | For each update, the DUT shall return either a SUCCESS or an INVALID_IN_STATE status code. • After all updates have been performed, verify that the value of the attribute reports from the subscription of each attribute came in sequentially in ascending order (each new value greater than the previous one). • Verify that the number of FanMode reports matches the number of PercentSetting reports. |

| 7 TH tests the • Attribute • Attribute PercentSetting present) • Update Actions: • Initialize and read written • Individually PercentSetting SpeedSetting attributes • Update attribute order, available the FanModeSequence excluding to 0 (Off) | For each update, the DUT shall return either a SUCCESS or an INVALID_IN_STATE status code. • After all updates have been performed, verify that the value of the attribute reports from the subscription of each attribute came in sequentially in descending order (each new value less than the previous one). • Verify that the number of FanMode reports matches the number of PercentSetting reports. |

Commission DUT to TH (can be skipped if done in a preceding test).

## Test Procedure

| # | TestStep | Expected Outcome |
| 2 | TH subscribes to the Fan control cluster | DUT returns SUCCESS |
| 3 | TH reads the supported fan modes from the FanModeSequence attribute | SUCCESS |
| 4 | If SPD is supported, TH reads SpeedMax | SUCCESS |
| 5 | TH sends the On command to the On/Off cluster | DUT returns SUCCESS |
| 6 | TH sets the FanMode attribute on the Fan Control cluster to High | DUT returns SUCCESS |
| 7 | TH reads the PercentSetting attribute from the Fan Control cluster and saves as percent_setting_original | SUCCESS |
| 8 | If the SPD feature is supported, TH reads the SpeedSetting attribute from the Fan Control cluster and saves as speed_setting_original | SUCCESS |

| 9 | TH reads the PercentCurrent attribute from the Fan Control cluster | SUCCESS |
| 10 | If PercentCurrent is not equal to PercentSetting, TH awaits an attribute report for the PercentCurrent matching PercentSetting | Report is received |
| 11 | TH sends the Off command to the On/Off cluster | DUT returns SUCCESS |
| 12 | TH awaits the following attribute reports (order does not matter): PercentCurrent is 0, SpeedCurrent is 0 (if SPD feature is supported) | Report(s) are received |
| 13 | TH reads the FanMode attribute | FanMode is set to HIGH |
| 14 | TH reads the PercentSetting attribute | PercentSetting matches `percent_setting_original |
| 15 | If the SPD feature is supported, TH reads the SpeedSetting | SpeedSetting matches speed_setting_original |
| 16 | Set the PercentSetting to 1. If the write returns INVALID_IN_STATE, skip the next six steps | INVALID_IN_STATE or SUCCESS |
| 17 | Read the FanMode | Verify FanMode is set to lowest supported mode above Off |
| 18 | Read PercentSetting | Verify PercentSetting is 1 |
| 19 | Wait for PIXIT.FanStartTime seconds | |
| 20 | Read PercentCurrent | PercentCurrent is 0 |
| 21 | If SPD is supported, Read SpeedSetting | Verify SpeedSetting is 1 |
| 22 | If SPD is supported, Read SpeedCurrent | SpeedCurrent is 0 |
| 23 | Set the PercentSetting to 0. If the write returns INVALID_IN_STATE, skip the next six steps | INVALID_IN_STATE or SUCCESS |
| 24 | Read the FanMode | Verify FanMode is set to Off |
| 25 | Read PercentSetting | Verify PercentSetting is 0 |
| 26 | Wait for PIXIT.FanStartTime seconds | |
| 27 | Read PercentCurrent | PercentCurrent is 0 |
| 28 | If SPD is supported, Read SpeedSetting | Verify SpeedSetting is 0 |
| 29 | If SPD is supported, Read SpeedCurrent | SpeedCurrent is 0 |
| 30 | Set the FanMode to High. If the write returns INVALID_IN_STATE, skip the next six steps | INVALID_IN_STATE or SUCCESS |

| 31 | Read the FanMode | Verify FanMode is set to High |
| 32 | Read PercentSetting | Verify PercentSetting is not 0 |
| 33 | Wait for PIXIT.FanStartTime seconds | |
| 34 | Read PercentCurrent | PercentCurrent is 0 |
| 35 | If SPD is supported, Read SpeedSetting | Verify SpeedSetting is not 0 |
| 36 | If SPD is supported, Read SpeedCurrent | SpeedCurrent is 0 |
| 37 | Set the FanMode to Off. If the write returns INVALID_IN_STATE, skip the next six steps | INVALID_IN_STATE or SUCCESS |
| 38 | Read the FanMode | Verify FanMode is set to Off |
| 39 | Read PercentSetting | Verify PercentSetting is 0 |
| 40 | Wait for PIXIT.FanStartTime seconds | |
| 41 | Read PercentCurrent | PercentCurrent is 0 |
| 42 | If SPD is supported, Read SpeedSetting | Verify SpeedSetting is 0 |
| 43 | If SPD is supported, Read SpeedCurrent | SpeedCurrent is 0 |
| 44 | If SPD is not supported, skip this step and the next 6 steps. Set the SpeedSetting to SpeedMax. If the write returns INVALID_IN_STATE, skip the next six steps | INVALID_IN_STATE or SUCCESS |
| 45 | Read the FanMode | Verify FanMode is set to High |
| 46 | Read PercentSetting | Verify PercentSetting is not 0 |
| 47 | Wait for PIXIT.FanStartTime seconds | |
| 48 | Read PercentCurrent | PercentCurrent is 0 |
| 49 | If SPD is supported, Read SpeedSetting | Verify SpeedSetting is SpeedMax |
| 50 | If SPD is supported, Read SpeedCurrent | SpeedCurrent is 0 |
| 51 | If SPD is not supported, skip this step and the next 6 steps. Set the SpeedSetting to 0. If the write returns INVALID_IN_STATE, skip the next six steps | INVALID_IN_STATE or SUCCESS |
| 52 | Read the FanMode | Verify FanMode is set to Off |
| 53 | Read PercentSetting | Verify PercentSetting is 0 |
| 54 | Wait for PIXIT.FanStartTime seconds | |
| 55 | Read PercentCurrent | PercentCurrent is 0 |
| 56 | If SPD is supported, Read SpeedSetting | Verify SpeedSetting is 0 |
| 57 | If SPD is supported, Read SpeedCurrent | SpeedCurrent is 0 |
| 58 | Set the PercentSetting to 100. If the write returns INVALID_IN_STATE, skip the next six steps | INVALID_IN_STATE or SUCCESS |

| 59 | Read the FanMode | Verify FanMode is set to High |
| 60 | Read PercentSetting | Verify PercentSetting is 100 |
| 61 | Wait for PIXIT.FanStartTime seconds | |
| 62 | Read PercentCurrent | PercentCurrent is 0 |
| 63 | If SPD is supported, Read SpeedSetting | Verify SpeedSetting is SpeedMax |
| 64 | If SPD is supported, Read SpeedCurrent | SpeedCurrent is 0 |
| 65 | TH reads the PercentSetting and SpeedSetting (if supported) values and saves as percent_setting_before_on and speed_setting_before_on | |
| 66 | TH sends On command to the On/Off cluster | DUT returns SUCCESS |
| 67 | TH awaits the following attribute reports (order does not matter): PercentCurrent is percent_setting_before_on , SpeedCurrent is speed_setting_before_on (if SPD feature is supported) | Reports are received |
| 68 | TH sets PercentSetting to 50 | Response is SUCCESS or INVALID_IN_STATE |
| 69 | If the response was SUCCESS, TH awaits the following attribute reports (order does not matter): PercentCurrent is 50, PercentSetting is 50 | Report(s) are received |

Functional

- OPSTATE.S
- OPSTATE.S.A0002(CountdownTime)

## Preconditions

| Doc. Ref. | Condition | Notes |

## Required Devices

| # | Device Name | Device Description |
| 1 | TH | TH as Client. |
| 2 | DUT | DUT as Server. |

## Test Procedure

| # | Ref | PICS | Test Step | Expected Outcome |
| 1 | | | Commission DUT to TH (can be skipped if done in a preceding test) | |
| 2 | | OPSTAT E.S.A000 2(Count downTi me) | Set up a subscription to the CountdownTime attribute, with MinIntervalFloor set to 0, MaxIntervalCeiling set to 30 and KeepSubscriptions set to false | Subscription successfully established |
| 3 | | | Manually put the DUT into a state where it will use the CountdownTime attribute, the initial value of the CountdownTime is greater than 30, and it will begin counting down the CountdownTime attribute. TH reads from the DUT the CountdownTime attribute. | If CountdownTime attribute is not null, verify TH receives at least one report transaction with an attribute report for the CountdownTime attribute with the reported time equal to the set time. |
| 4 | | | TH reads from the DUT the CountdownTime attribute | If the result is null, skip the next step |

| 6 | | TH reads from the DUT the CountdownTime attribute TH reads from the DUT the OperationalState attribute | If CountdownTime is null or OperationalState is not Running(0x01), skip the next step |
| 8 | | Manually put the DUT into a state where it will use the CountdownTime attribute, the initial value of the CountdownTime is greater than 30, and it will begin counting down the CountdownTime attribute. TH reads from the DUT the CountdownTime attribute. | If CountdownTime attribute is not null, verify TH receives at least one report transaction with an attribute report |
| 10 | | TH reads from the DUT the CountdownTime attribute | If the result is null, skip the next step |

Given the it is not possible to force a device into setting the attributes to null, the requirement of:

- It changed from null to any other value and vice versa

is currently not validated in this test case.

## TC-REFALM-2.2 Primary functionality with DUT as Server

## Purpose

This test case verifies the primary functionality of the Refrigerator Alarm Cluster server.

## PICS

- REFALM.S

## Required Devices

| # | Device Name | Device Description |
| 1 | TH | TH as Client. |
| 2 | DUT | DUT as Server. |

## Device Topology

TH and DUT are on the same fabric.

## Test Procedure

| # | TestStep | Expected Outcome |
| 1 | Commission DUT to TH (can be skipped if done in a preceding test) | |
| 2 | Ensure that the door on the DUT is closed | |
| 3 | TH reads from the DUT the State attribute | Verify that the DUT response contains a 32- bit value with bit 0 set to 0 |
| 4 | Manually open the door on the DUT | |
| 5 | Wait for the time defined in PIXIT.REFALM.AlarmThreshold | |
| 6 | TH reads from the DUT the State attribute | Verify that the DUT response contains a 32- bit value with bit 0 set to 1 |
| 7 | Ensure that the door on the DUT is closed | |

| 8 | TH reads from the DUT the State attribute | Verify that the DUT response contains a 32- bit value with bit 0 set to 0 |
| 9 | TH sends Reset command to the DUT | Verify DUT responds w/ status UNSUPPORTED_COMMAND(0x81) |
| 10 | TH sends ModifyEnabledAlarms command to the DUT | Verify DUT responds w/ status UNSUPPORTED_COMMAND(0x81) |
| 11 | Set up subscription to the Notify event | |
| 12 | Repeat steps 4 and then 5 | After step 5 (repeated), receive a Notify event with the State attribute bit 0 set to 1. |

## Notes/Testing Considerations

## TC-SMOKECO-2.6 ExpressedState Attribute - Multiple Alarms with DUT as Server

## Purpose

This test case verifies that the ExpressedState Attribute indicates the highest priority alarm during multiple alarms condition of the Smoke CO Alarm Cluster server. The design of the test case intends to include both Smoke and CO alarms in multiple alarms condition, therefore a Smoke and CO combo device is required.

## Notes/Testing Considerations

For an EVSE which also supports the PREF feature:

This test aims to validate that the NextChargeTargetSoC takes precedence over the NextChargeRequiredEnergy if the vehicle StateOfCharge is available. If StateOfCharge is not available then the NextChargeRequiredEnergy is used.

It also aims to validate that if the current StateOfCharge &gt; TargetSoC then there should be no NextChargeStartTime.

## Chapter 86. Thread Border Router Management Cluster Test Plan

## 86.1. PICS Definition

This section covers the Thread Border Router Management Cluster Cluster Test Plan related PICS items that are referenced in the following test cases. Support for an item is considered as "true" for conditional statements within the test case steps.

## 86.1.1. Role

| Variable | Description | Mandatory/Optional | Notes/Additional Constraints |
| TBRM.S | Does the device implement the Thread Border Router Management Cluster as a server? | O | |
| TBRM.C | Does the device implement the Thread Border Router Management Cluster as a client? | O | |

## 86.1.2. Server

## Features

| Variable | Description | Mandatory/Optional | Notes/Additional Constraints |
| TBRM.S.F00(PC) | Does the device support the ability to change PAN configuration with pending dataset setting request. | TBRM.S:O | |

## Attributes

| Variable | Description | Mandatory/Optional | Notes/Additional Constraints |
| TBRM.S.A0000(BorderR outerName) | Does the device implement the BorderRouterName attribute? | TBRM.S:M | |

| TBRM.S.A0001(BorderA gentID) | Does the device implement the BorderAgentID attribute? | TBRM.S:M |
| TBRM.S.A0002(ThreadV ersion) | Does the device implement the ThreadVersion attribute? | TBRM.S:M |
| TBRM.S.A0003(Interfac eEnabled) | Does the device implement the InterfaceEnabled attribute? | TBRM.S:M |
| TBRM.S.A0004(ActiveD atasetTimestamp) | Does the device implement the ActiveDatasetTimestam p attribute? | TBRM.S:M |
| TBRM.S.A0005(Pending DatasetTimestamp) | Does the device implement the PendingDatasetTimesta mp attribute? | TBRM.S:M |

## Commands received

| Variable | Description | Mandatory/Optional | Notes/Additional Constraints |
| TBRM.S.C00.Rsp(GetAct iveDatasetRequest) | Does the device implement receiving the GetActiveDatasetReques t command? | TBRM.S:M | |
| TBRM.S.C01.Rsp(GetPen dingDatasetRequest) | Does the device implement receiving the GetPendingDatasetRequ est command? | TBRM.S:M | |
| TBRM.S.C03.Rsp(SetActi veDatasetRequest) | Does the device implement receiving the SetActiveDatasetReques t command? | TBRM.S:M | |

| TBRM.S.C04.Rsp(SetPen dingDatasetRequest) | Does the device implement receiving the SetPendingDatasetRequ est command? | TBRM.S.F00(PC) |

## Commands generated

| Variable | Description | Mandatory/Optional | Notes/Additional Constraints |
| TBRM.S.C02.Tx(Dataset Response) | Does the device implement sending the DatasetResponse command? | TBRM.S:M | |

## 86.1.3. Client

## Commands received

| Variable | Description | Mandatory/Optional | Notes/Additional Constraints |
| TBRM.C.C02.Rsp(Datase tResponse) | Does the DUT(client) support receiving of the DatasetResponse command? | TBRM.C:O | |

## Commands generated

| Variable | Description | Mandatory/Optional | Notes/Additional Constraints |
| TBRM.C.C00.Tx(GetActi veDatasetRequest) | Does the DUT(client) support transmitting the GetActiveDatasetReques t command? | TBRM.C:O | |
| TBRM.C.C01.Tx(GetPen dingDatasetRequest) | Does the DUT(client) support transmitting the GetPendingDatasetRequ est command? | TBRM.C:O | |
| TBRM.C.C03.Tx(SetActiv eDatasetRequest) | Does the DUT(client) support transmitting the SetActiveDatasetReques t command? | TBRM.C:O | |

| TBRM.C.C04.Tx(SetPend ingDatasetRequest) | Does the DUT(client) support transmitting the SetPendingDatasetRequ est command? | TBRM.C:O |

| Variable | Description | Mandatory/Optional | Notes/Additional Constraints |
| PIXIT.TBRM.THREAD_A CTIVE_DATASET | Valid Thread OperationalDataset | | |

## TC-ECOINFO-2.1 Attributes with DUT as Server

## Purpose

For devices that support Fabric Sync, confirm node has an Ecosystem Information Cluster when there is a bridged device attached and that non-global attributes meet conformance.

## PICS

## · ECOINFO.S|MCORE.FS

## Precondition

| # | Doc. Ref. | Condition | Notes |
| 1 | | DUT (Aggregator/Bridge) has been commissioned to TH | |
| 2 | | One or more bridged devices of a supported type connected to DUT (Aggregator/Bridge). | |

## Required Devices

| # | Device Name | Device Description |
| 1 | TH | Test Harness as Administrator, Controller |
| 2 | DUT | DUT (Aggregator/Bridge device with some bridged devices) |

## Device Topology

TH and DUT are on the same fabric.

## Test Setup

Manufacturer has provided Aggregator/Bridge as DUT with some devices it can bridge, along with means to setup the bridge (e.g. add/remove bridged devices).

## Test Procedure

| # | Test Step | Expected Outcome |

| 1 | TH Reads how many EcosystemInformation cluster there are on the DUT | On TH validate that there exists at least 1 Ecosystem Information Cluster |
| 2 | TH Reads DeviceDirectory attribute | Verify DUT responded: • For each entry in the list: ◦ If fabricIndex matches TH fabricIndex: ▪ If DeviceName is provided: ▪ Value is string and contains at most 64 characters ▪ DeviceNameLastEdit contains non-zero value. ▪ Else: ▪ DeviceNameLastEdit is not provided. ▪ BridgedEndpoint is endpoint-no type (MAY be invalid endpoint value) ▪ OriginalEndpoint is endpoint-no type and is NOT invalid endpoint value. ▪ DeviceTypes contains at least 1 entry. ▪ For each entry in DeviceTypes : ▪ DeviceType is valid DeviceType ID ▪ Revision is >= 1 ▪ Verify there is no more than 64 entries in UniqueLocationIds ▪ For each entry in UniqueLocationIds : ▪ Verify value is string and contains at most 64 characters. ▪ If sizeof(UniqueLocationIds) >= 1: ▪ UniqueLocationIdsLastEdit is non-zero value. ◦ Else: ▪ No other fields exist in entry. |

| 3 | TH Reads LocationDirectory attribute | Verify DUT responded: |
| 4 | Try writing different value to DeviceDirectory Attribute | Verify DUT responds with UNSUPPORTED_WRITE |
| 5 | Try writing different value to LocationDirectory Attribute | Verify DUT responds with UNSUPPORTED_WRITE |
| 6 | Repeat steps 2 to 5 for each cluster identified in step 1 | |

## Notes/Testing Considerations

- ACE tests normally check that attributes that are read only are not able to be written to. The reason the are located in this test case is because Ecosystem Information Cluster is expected to only show up on dynamic endpoint. As such it is a part of this test plan explicitly.
- Testing expected behavior with respect to Attribute changes when a device is added/removed is in [TC-ECOINFO-2.2]

## TC-ECOINFO-2.2 Changing the set of bridged devices DUT as Server

## Purpose

For devices that support Fabric Sync, test case verifies the functionality of the ecosystem information cluster when bridged devices are being added or deleted.

## · ECOINFO.S|MCORE.FS

## Precondition

| # | Doc. Ref. | Condition | Notes |
| 1 | | DUT (Aggregator/Bridge) has been commissioned to TH | |

## Required Devices

| # | Device Name | Device Description |
| 1 | TH | Test Harness as Administrator, Controller |
| 2 | DUT | DUT (Aggregator/Bridge device with some bridged devices) |

## Device Topology

TH and DUT are on the same fabric.

## Test Setup

Manufacturer has provided Aggregator/Bridge as DUT with some devices it can bridge, along with means to setup the bridge (e.g. add/remove bridged devices).

## Test Procedure

| # | Test Step | Expected Outcome |
| 1: Preparation | 1: Preparation | 1: Preparation |
| 1a | Read the PartsList attribute of the Descriptor cluster of endpoint 0 (root endpoint) | Results will be used in later steps |
| 1b | For each endpoint listed in the PartsList attribute in step 1a, read the DeviceTypeList attributes of the Descriptor cluster. | FAIL if no Aggregator device types is found |
| 2: Add a bridged device | 2: Add a bridged device | 2: Add a bridged device |
| 2a | Add a bridged device (using a method indicated by the manufacturer) | |
| 2b | Read the PartsList attribute of the Descriptor cluster on endpoint 0(root endpoint) | • Verify that PartsList contains exactly one more endpoint which previously was not present in 1a |

| 3: Remove bridged device | 3: Remove bridged device | 3: Remove bridged device |
| 3a | Remove bridged device that was added in step 2 | |
| 3b | Read the PartsList attribute of the Descriptor cluster on endpoint 0(root endpoint) | • Verify that PartsList equals what was read in 1a. |
| 3c | On endpoint detected in 2b, read DeviceDirectory | Verify attribute read failed on UnsupportedEndpoint. |
| 3d | On endpoint detected in 2b, read LocationDirectory | Verify attribute read failed on UnsupportedEndpoint. |

## Notes/Testing Considerations

Many of the Bridge related aspects to be validated are in [TC-BR-2]. This focuses on EcosystemInformation Cluster specifically.

| 4 | TH Reads event CommissioningRequestResult from DUT | Saves eventNumber as requestEventNumber to be used in future validation. This MAY (likely will) fail to read if no event exists. If that happens continue testing and use requestEventNumber = 0 |
| 10 | TH Reads event CommissioningRequestResult from DUT with number filter requestEventNumber from step 4 | Validates DUT has not sent any new CommissioningRequestResult events since step 4. If step 4 failed to read event, this step will fail to read event. That would confirm no new event has occurred and test should continue. |
| 13 | TH Reads event CommissioningRequestResult from DUT with number filter requestEventNumber from step 4 | Validates one new event CommissioningRequestResult that contains: • RequestId: 0x12345678_87654321 • ClientNodeId: matches TH node ID • StatusCode: Success |

| 14 | TH Executes CommissionNode Command to DUT over CASE session with the following parameters: • RequestId: 0x12345678_87654322 • ResponseTimeoutSeconds: 30 | Validate DUT responds with FAILURE status (mismatching RequestID) |
| 15 | TH Executes CommissionNode Command to DUT over CASE session with the following parameters: • RequestId: 0x12345678_87654321 • ResponseTimeoutSeconds: 29 | Validate DUT responds with FAILURE status (invalid ResponseTimeoutSeconds) |
| 16 | TH Executes CommissionNode Command to DUT over CASE session with the following parameters: • RequestId: 0x12345678_87654321 • ResponseTimeoutSeconds: 121 | Validate DUT responds with FAILURE status (invalid ResponseTimeoutSeconds) |
| 18 | TH uses values from step 17 ReverseOpenCommissioningWindow as parameters to OpenCommissioningWindow command on Administrator Commissioning Cluster sent to TH_SERVER | Validate Command was successful # Need to wait here since we are checking DUT does not commission TH_SERVER. There are no optimization here that we can realistically take # other than potentially failing a little earlier if we detect number of fabric change earlier but this isn't worth the development effort. |
| 19 | TH waits 30 seconds | |

| 24 | TH Reads event CommissioningRequestResult from DUT with number filter requestEventNumber + 1 from step 4 | Validates one new event CommissioningRequestResult that contains: • RequestId: 0x12345678_12345678 • ClientNodeId: matches TH node ID • StatusCode: Success |
| 26 | TH uses values from step 25 ReverseOpenCommissioningWindow as parameters to OpenCommissioningWindow command on Administrator Commissioning Cluster sent to TH_SERVER | Validate Command was successful. # Between step above and below the DUT is supposed to commission the TH_SERVER over PASE. All of this is done automatically by DUT to be spec compliant. |

| # | Ref | PICS | Test Step | Expected Outcome |
| 15 | | | TH sends command AddNetwork with the value of TestNetworkDataset in the OperationalDataset field, i.e. with the original / lower Active Timestamp, using a Timed Interaction. | Verify DUT responds w/ status INVALID_IN_STATE(0xcb) |

| # | Ref | PICS | Test Step | Expected Outcome |
| 25 | | | TH writes to the DUT the PreferredExtendedPanID attribute to initialPreferredExtendedPanID . | Verify DUT responds w/ status SUCCESS(0x00) |

## Notes/Testing Considerations

The test references a number of values that define a Thread Operational Dataset, as well as some of the attributes that it encodes. While the dataset and the attribute values are arbitrary, the dataset must be valid and the attributes must match what is encoded in the dataset.

- TestNetworkDataset an octstr, e.g. hex:0e0800000000000c0001000300000f350407fff800020839758ec8144b07fb0708fdf1f1add0797dc0 0510f366cec7a446bab978d90d27abe38f23030f4f70656e5468726561642d353933380102593804103c a67c969efb0d0c74a4d8ee923b576c0c0402a0f7f8
- TestNetworkExtendedPanId : The Extended Pan ID of the network as an octstr, e.g. hex:39758ec8144b07fb
- TestNetworkName : The Network Name of the network as a string, e.g. "OpenThread-5938"
- TestNetworkChannel : The Channel Number of the network, e.g. 15
- TestNetworkActiveTimestamp : The Active Timestamp value of the network, e.g. 1
- TestNetworkUpdatedDataset : A copy of TestNetworkDataset updated with a larger Active Timestamp, e.g. hex:0e0800000000000d0001000300000f350407fff800020839758ec8144b07fb0708fdf1f1add0797dc0 0510f366cec7a446bab978d90d27abe38f23030f4f70656e5468726561642d353933380102593804103c

a67c969efb0d0c74a4d8ee923b576c0c0402a0f7f8

## Chapter 95. WebRTC Transport Provider Cluster Test Plan

## 95.1. PICS Definition

This section covers the WebRTC Transport Provider Cluster Test Plan related PICS items that are referenced in the following test cases. Support for an item is considered as "true" for conditional statements within the test case steps.

## 95.1.1. Role

| Variable | Description | Mandatory/Optional | Notes/Additional Constraints |
| WEBRTCP.S | Does the device implement the WebRTC Transport Provider Cluster cluster as a server? | M | Required for devices supporting WebRTC streaming |

## 95.1.2. Server

## Features

| Variable | Description | Mandatory/Optional | Notes/Additional Constraints |
| WEBRTCP.S.F00(META DATA) | Does the device support Supports metadata transmission in WebRTC sessions? | WEBRTCP.S: P,O | |

## Attributes

| Variable | Description | Mandatory/Optional | Notes/Additional Constraints |
| WEBRTCP.S.A0000(Curr entSessions) | Does the DUT(server) support the CurrentSessions attribute? | M | |

| Variable | Description | Mandatory/Optional | Notes/Additional Constraints |

| WEBRTCP.S.C00.Rsp(Sol icitOffer) | Does the device implement the SolicitOffer command? | WEBRTCP.S:M |
| WEBRTCP.S.C02.Rsp(Pr ovideOffer) | Does the device implement the ProvideOffer command? | WEBRTCP.S:M |
| WEBRTCP.S.C04.Rsp(Pr ovideAnswer) | Does the device implement the ProvideAnswer command? | WEBRTCP.S:M |
| WEBRTCP.S.C05.Rsp(Pr ovideICECandidates) | Does the device implement the ProvideICECandidates command? | WEBRTCP.S:M |
| WEBRTCP.S.C06.Rsp(En dSession) | Does the device implement the EndSession command? | WEBRTCP.S:M |

## 95.3. Test Cases

## 95.3.1. Server

## TC-WEBRTCP-2.1 Validate delayed processing of SolicitOffer with DUT as Server

## Purpose

Verify that the provider defers processing when in standby/low-power mode, and start a new session on the WebRTCProvider Cluster server.

## PICS

- WEBRTCP.S

## Precondition

| 0 | | DUT WebRTC Transport Provider Cluster is at revision 1 | 1 |
| | DUT (Camera) is started with delayed processing enabled | | 2 |
| | DUT (Camera) has been commissioned to TH | | 3 |

| Confirm no active WebRTC sessions exist in DUT | | 4 |
| HardPrivacyModeOn = FALSE | Vendors whose devices power-up with HardPrivacyModeOn = TRUE must provide instructions to the test lab on how to place the device in HardPrivacyModeOff | 5 |

## Required Devices

| # | Device Name | Description |
| 1 | TH | Test Harness Controller |
| 2 | DUT | WebRTCProvider-enabled device (e.g., Camera) |

## Device Topology

- TH and DUT are on the same fabric.

## Test Setup

The manufacturer has supplied a Raspberry Pi 4 or later with a Raspberry Pi Camera Module 3 as the DUT, set in standby mode.

## Test Procedure

| # | Test Step | Expected Outcome |
| 1 | TH reads CurrentSessions attribute from WebRTC Transport Provider Cluster on DUT | Verify the number of WebRTCSession in the list is 0. |
| 3 | TH sends the SolicitOffer command with a VideoStreamID does not match a value in AllocatedVideoStreams and StreamUsage = 3(kLiveView) | DUT responds with DYNAMIC_CONSTRAINT_ERROR status code. |
| 4 | TH sends the SolicitOffer command with a AudioStreamID does not match a value in AllocatedAudioStreams and StreamUsage = 3(kLiveView) | DUT responds with DYNAMIC_CONSTRAINT_ERROR status code. |

| 7 | TH reads CurrentSessions attribute from WebRTC Transport Provider Cluster on DUT | Verify the number of WebRTCSession is 1. • For each entry in the list: ◦ ID is uint16 type and contains a valid value (starting from 0). ◦ PeerNodeID is node-id type and contains a valid node-id value. ◦ PeerEndpointID is endpoint-no type and contains a valid endpoint value. ◦ StreamUsage is StreamUsageEnum type and contains a valid StreamUsageEnum value. ◦ VideoStreamID is uint16 type. ◦ AudioStreamID is uint16 type. |

For the single session entry, verify all of the following: (a) id is a uint16 integer in the range 0-65534; (b) peerNodeID is a non-zero node-id integer; (c) peerEndpointID is an integer in the valid endpoint range 0-65534; (d) streamUsage is a valid known StreamUsageEnum value (not kUnknownEnumValue); (e) id matches the WebRTCSessionID returned in the SolicitOfferResponse from Step 3; (f) videoStreamID is not null; (g) audioStreamID is not null. |

## TC-WEBRTCP-2.5 Validate interaction of SolicitOffer and stream allocation with DUT as Server

## Purpose

Verify the SolicitOffer command behaviour in conjunction with underlying stream allocation DUT as Server.

## PICS

- WEBRTCP.S
- AVSM.S

## Precondition

| 0 | | DUT WebRTC Transport Provider Cluster is at revision 1 | 1 |
| | DUT (Camera) has been commissioned to TH | | 2 |

## Required Devices

| # | Device Name | Description |
| 1 | TH | Test Harness Controller |
| 2 | DUT | WebRTCProvider-enabled device (e.g., Camera) |

## Device Topology

- TH and DUT are on the same fabric.

## Test Setup

The manufacturer has supplied a Raspberry Pi 4 or later with a Raspberry Pi Camera Module 3 as the DUT.

## Test Procedure

| # | Test Step | Expected Outcome |
| 2 | TH sends a SolicitOffer command with no audio or video id | Verify that the DUT response contains INVALID_COMMAND failure response |
| 3 | TH sends a SolicitOffer command with valid parameters, audio and video stream IDs are Null | Verify that the DUT response contains INVALID_IN_STATE failure response |
| 4 | TH allocates a Video stream via VideoStreamAllocate command to CameraAVStreamManagement | Verify that the DUT response contains success |
| 5 | TH sends a SolicitOffer command with valid parameters, audio stream ID is Null, video stream ID is for the allocated stream | Verify that the DUT response contains INVALID_IN_STATE failure response |
| 6 | TH allocates an Audio stream via AudioStreamAllocate command to CameraAVStreamManagement | Verify that the DUT response contains success |
| 7 | TH sends a SolicitOffer command with valid parameters, audio stream ID is the allocated stream ID, video stream ID is invalid | Verify that the DUT response contains DYNAMIC_CONSTRAINT_ERROR failure response |
| 8 | TH sends a SolicitOffer command with a supported stream usage that doesn't match the allocated streams, but with the allocated stream IDs | Verify that that DUT's reply is a SolicitOfferResponse |
| 9 | TH sends a SolicitOffer command with an unsupported stream usage, but with the allocated stream IDs | Verify that the DUT response contains DYNAMIC_CONSTRAINT_ERROR |
| 10 | TH sends a SolicitOffer command with a supported stream usage that doesn't match the allocated streams, and with audio and video stream IDs set to null | Verify that that DUT's reply is a SolicitOfferResponse that contains stream IDs that match the allocated streams |

| 11 | TH sends a SolicitOffer command with a stream usage that matches the allocated streams, and with the allocated stream IDs | Verify that that DUT's reply is a SolicitOfferResponse, save the included WebRTCSessionID |
| 12 | TH reads CurrentSessions attribute from WebRTC Transport Provider Cluster on DUT | Verify DUT responds w/ status SUCCESS(0x00). Verify the number of WebRTCSessions in the list is 3. |
| 13 | TH sends an EndSession command with an invalid WebRTCSessionID | Verify that the DUT response contains NOT_FOUND failure response |
| 14 | TH sends an EndSession command with the WebRTCSessionID from step 11 | Verify that the DUT response contains success |

| 7 | TH writes SoftLivestreamPrivacyModeEnabled to FALSE, TH sends the ProvideOffer command with a null WebRTCSessionID, a VideoStreams with a valid VideoStreamID, an AudioStreams with a valid AudioStreamID, and valid values for the other parameters and StreamUsage = LiveView. | DUT responds with ProvideOfferResponse containing allocated WebRTCSessionID. |

## TC-WEBRTCP-2.31 Validate interaction of SolicitOffer and stream allocation with DUT as Server-Release 1.5.1 or later - PROVISIONAL

## Purpose

Verify the SolicitOffer command behaviour in conjunction with underlying stream allocation DUT as Server.

## PICS

- WEBRTCP.S
- AVSM.S

## Precondition

| 0 | | DUT WebRTC Transport Provider Cluster is at revision 2 or higher | 1 |
| | DUT (Camera) has been commissioned to TH | | 2 |

## Required Devices

| # | Device Name | Description |
| 1 | TH | Test Harness Controller |
| 2 | DUT | WebRTCProvider-enabled device (e.g., Camera) |

## Device Topology

- TH and DUT are on the same fabric.

## Test Setup

The manufacturer has supplied a Raspberry Pi 4 or later with a Raspberry Pi Camera Module 3 as the DUT.

## Test Procedure

| # | Test Step | Expected Outcome |
| 1 | TH reads CurrentSessions attribute from WebRTC Transport Provider Cluster on DUT | Verify that the DUT response contains success. Verify the number of WebRTCSession in the list is 0. |
| 2 | TH sends a SolicitOffer command with no audio or video streams | Verify that the DUT response contains INVALID_COMMAND failure response |
| 3 | TH allocates a Video stream via VideoStreamAllocate command to CameraAVStreamManagement | Verify that the DUT response contains success |

| 4 | TH allocates an Audio stream via AudioStreamAllocate command to CameraAVStreamManagement | Verify that the DUT response contains success |
| 5 | TH sends a SolicitOffer command with valid parameters, an AudioStreams with an AudioStreamID that is the allocated stream ID, a VideoStreams with a VideoStreamID that is invalid | Verify that the DUT response contains DYNAMIC_CONSTRAINT_ERROR failure response |
| 6 | TH sends a SolicitOffer command with a supported stream usage that doesn't match the allocated streams, but with the allocated stream IDs | Verify that that DUT's reply is a SolicitOfferResponse |
| 7 | TH sends a SolicitOffer command with an unsupported stream usage, but with the allocated stream IDs | Verify that the DUT response contains DYNAMIC_CONSTRAINT_ERROR |
| 8 | TH sends a SolicitOffer command with a stream usage that matches the allocated streams, and with the allocated stream IDs in VideoStreams and AudioStreams | Verify that that DUT's reply is a SolicitOfferResponse, save the included WebRTCSessionID |
| 9 | TH reads CurrentSessions attribute from WebRTC Transport Provider Cluster on DUT | Verify DUT responds w/ status SUCCESS(0x00). Verify the number of WebRTCSessions in the list is 3. |
| 10 | TH sends an EndSession command with an invalid WebRTCSessionID | Verify that the DUT response contains NOT_FOUND failure response |
| 11 | TH sends an EndSession command with the WebRTCSessionID from step 8 | Verify that the DUT response contains success |

## Chapter 98. Closure Dimension Cluster Test Plan

## 98.1. PICS Definition

This section covers the Closure Dimension Cluster Test Plan related PICS items that are referenced in the following test cases. Support for an item is considered as "true" for conditional statements within the test case steps.

## 98.1.1. Role

| Variable | Description | Mandatory/Optional | Notes/Additional Constraints |
| CLDIM.S | Does the device implement the Closure Dimension cluster as a server? | O | |

## 98.1.2. Server

## Features

| Variable | Description | Mandatory/Optional | Notes/Additional Constraints |
| CLDIM.S.F00(PS) | Does the device support Positioning in the range from 0.00% to 100.00% | CLDIM.S: O.a+ | |
| CLDIM.S.F01(LT) | Does the device support MotionLatching to secure the closure to a position or state | CLDIM.S: O.a+ | |
| CLDIM.S.F02(UT) | Does the device support Unit for this dimension (mm, degrees etc.) | CLDIM.S: [PS] | |
| CLDIM.S.F03(LM) | Does the device support Limitation of the operating range | CLDIM.S: [PS] | |
| CLDIM.S.F05(TR) | Does the device support Translation motion | CLDIM.S: [PS].b | |

| CLDIM.S.F06(RO) | Does the device support Rotation motion CLDIM.S: [PS].b |
| CLDIM.S.F07(MD) | Does the device support Modulation of a particular flow level (light, air, privacy …) CLDIM.S: [PS].b |

| Variable | Description | Mandatory/Optional | Notes/Additional Constraints |
| CLDIM.S.A0000(Current State) | Does the device implement the CurrentState attribute? | CLDIM.S:M | |
| CLDIM.S.A0001(TargetS tate) | Does the device implement the TargetState attribute? | CLDIM.S:M | |
| CLDIM.S.A0002(Resolut ion) | Does the device implement the Resolution attribute? | CLDIM.S: CLDIM.S.F00(PS) | |
| CLDIM.S.A0003(StepVal ue) | Does the device implement the StepValue attribute? | CLDIM.S: CLDIM.S.F00(PS) | |
| CLDIM.S.A0004(Unit) | Does the device implement the Unit attribute? | CLDIM.S: CLDIM.S.F02(UT) | |
| CLDIM.S.A0005(UnitRa nge) | Does the device implement the UnitRange attribute? | CLDIM.S: CLDIM.S.F02(UT) | |
| CLDIM.S.A0006(LimitRa nge) | Does the device implement the LimitRange attribute? | CLDIM.S: CLDIM.S.F03(LM) | |
| CLDIM.S.A0007(Transla tionDirection) | Does the device implement the TranslationDirection attribute? | CLDIM.S: CLDIM.S.F05(TR) | |

## Category

Functional conformance

## Purpose

This test case verifies the operation of the Step command of the Closure Dimension server.

- CLDIM.S.F00(PS)

## Preconditions

| # | Doc. Ref. | Condition | Notes |

| 2 | DUT | DUT as Server. |

TH and DUT are on the same fabric.

## Test Setup

Commission DUT to TH (can be skipped if done in a preceding test).

- Default values to be used if LimitRange is not supported:
- MinPosition = 0 (0.00%)
- MaxPosition = 10000 (100.00%)

## Test Procedure

| # | Test Step | Expected Outcome |
| 1 | Commission DUT to TH (can be skipped if done in a preceding test). | |
| 2a | TH reads from the DUT the FeatureMap attribute | Verify that the DUT response contains the FeatureMap attribute. # 2b can be removed, added PICS to not select the test if not necessary. |

| 2e | TH establishes a wildcard subscription to all attributes on Closure Dimension Cluster, with • MinIntervalFloor = 0 • MaxIntervalCeiling = 30 • KeepSubscriptions = false | Subscription successfully established |
| 2l | Operate on device to set CurrentState.Latch attribute manually to Unlatched | |
| Make sure position is at MaxPosition | Make sure position is at MaxPosition | Make sure position is at MaxPosition |
| 3a | TH sends Step command to DUT, with Direction = Increase(1) and NumberOfSteps = 65535 (0xFFFF) | Verify DUT responds w/ status SUCCESS(0x00) |

| Validate step functionality | Validate step functionality | Validate step functionality |
| 4a | TH sends Step command to DUT, with Direction = Decrease(0) , NumberOfSteps = 2 | Verify DUT responds w/ status SUCCESS(0x00) |
| 4c | Wait until TH receives a subscription report with CurrentState.Position = Max( MaxPosition - 2*StepValue , MinPosition ). | Subscription report received with CurrentState.Position = Max( MaxPosition - 2*StepValue , MinPosition ) |
| 4d | TH sends Step command to DUT, with Direction = Increase(1) , NumberOfSteps = 2 | Verify DUT responds w/ status SUCCESS(0x00) |
| 4f | Wait until TH receives a subscription report with CurrentState.Position = MaxPosition | Subscription report received with CurrentState.Position = MaxPosition |
| Validate step functionality, Speed = High(3) | Validate step functionality, Speed = High(3) | Validate step functionality, Speed = High(3) |
| 5a | If SP feature is not supported on the cluster, skip step 5b to 5d | |
| 5b | TH sends Step command to DUT, with Direction = Decrease(0) , NumberOfSteps = 1 and speed = High(3) | Verify DUT responds w/ status SUCCESS(0x00) |
| | | TargetState.Speed Value has to be High(3) |

| 5d | Wait until TH receives a subscription report with CurrentState.Position = ( MaxPosition - StepValue ) and CurrentState.Speed = High(3) . | Subscription report received with CurrentState.Position = ( MaxPosition - StepValue ) and CurrentState.Speed = High(3) |
| Validate step functionality, Speed = Auto(0) | Validate step functionality, Speed = Auto(0) | Validate step functionality, Speed = Auto(0) |
| 6a | If SP feature is not supported on the cluster, skip step 6b to 6d | |
| 6b | TH sends Step command to DUT, with Direction = Increase(1) , NumberOfSteps = 1 and speed = Auto(0) | Verify DUT responds w/ status SUCCESS(0x00) |
| Validate stop at limits | Validate stop at limits | Validate stop at limits |
| 7b | TH sends Step command to DUT, with Direction = Decrease(0) and NumberOfSteps = 65535 (0xFFFF) | Verify DUT responds w/ status SUCCESS(0x00) |
| 7e | TH sends Step command to DUT, with Direction = Increase(1) and NumberOfSteps = 65535 (0xFFFF) | Verify DUT responds w/ status SUCCESS(0x00) |

| 7g | Wait until TH receives a subscription report with CurrentState.Position = MaxPosition | Subscription report received with CurrentState.Position = MaxPosition |

## TC-CHIME-2.4 Verify the PlayChimeSound functionality with DUT as Server

## Purpose

This test case verifies the PlayChimeSound functionality of the Chime server.

## · CHIME.S

## Required Devices

| # | Device Name | Device Description |
| 1 | TH | TH as Client. |
| 2 | DUT | DUT as Server. |

## Device Topology

TH and DUT are on the same fabric.

## Test Setup

Commission DUT to TH (can be skipped if done in a preceding test).

## Test Procedure

| # | Ref | PICS | Test Step | Expected Outcome |
| 2 | | | TH writes to the DUT the Enabled attribute to False | Verify DUT responds w/ status SUCCESS(0x00) |
| 3 | | | TH sends command PlayChimeSound to DUT | Verify DUT responds w/ status SUCCESS(0x00), and that no chime sound is heard |
| 4 | | | TH writes to the DUT the Enabled attribute to True | Verify DUT responds w/ status SUCCESS(0x00) |
| 6 | | | Ensure that the SelectedChime is the longest chime (in duration) available on the DUT | Verify DUT responds w/ status SUCCESS(0x00) once the attribute is written |
| 7 | | | TH sends command PlayChimeSound three times to the DUT in rapid succession | Verify DUT responds w/ status SUCCESS(0x00) in each instance, and that no more than two distinct chime sounds are heard. Manually acknowledge the the sound(s) was(were) heard. |

| 8 | If there is more than one chime sound supported, proceed with step 9, otherwise end the test case | |
| 9 | TH sends command PlayChimeSound to DUT | Verify DUT responds w/ status SUCCESS(0x00) |
| 10 | TH writes to the DUT the SelectedChime attribute to a different value found in myChimeSounds. | Verify DUT responds w/ status SUCCESS(0x00) |
| 11 | Obtain manual verification that the chime sound was heard and is complete | |
| 12 | TH sends command PlayChimeSound to DUT | Verify DUT responds w/ status SUCCESS(0x00), and that a different (from step 11) chime sound is heard. |

Note that this should not update the CurrentPrice attribute or cause the PriceChange event to be sent. |

## Chapter 104. Camera AV Stream Management Cluster Test Plan

## 104.1. PICS Definition

This section covers the Camera AV Stream Management Cluster Test Plan related PICS items that are referenced in the following test cases. Support for an item is considered as "true" for conditional statements within the test case steps.

## 104.1.1. Role

| Variable | Description | Mandatory/Optional | Notes/Additional Constraints |
| AVSM.S | Does the device implement the Camera AV Stream Management cluster as a server? | O | |
| AVSM.C | Does the device implement the Camera AV Stream Management cluster as a client? | O | |

## 104.1.2. Server

| GC.S | Does the device implement the Groupcast Cluster as server? | O | Node-scoped cluster |

## 111.1.2. Server

## Features

| Variable | Description | Mandatory/Optional | Notes/Additional Constraints |
| GC.S.F00(LN) | Does the device implement "Listener" feature? | GC.S : O.a+ | Enables receiving multicast targeted group messages |
| GC.S.F01(SD) | Does the device implement "Sender" feature? | GC.S : O.a+ | Enables sending multicast messages to groups |

## Attributes

| Variable | Description | Mandatory/Optional | Notes/Additional Constraints |
| GC.S.A0000(Membershi p) | Does the device implement the Membership attribute? | GC.S: P,M | Fabric-scoped list of MembershipStruct entries |
| GC.S.A0001(MaxMembe rshipCount) | Does the device implement the MaxMembershipCount attribute? | GC.S: P,M | Min value SHALL be 10 (spec) |

| GC.S.A0002(MaxMcastA ddrCount) | Does the device implement the MaxMcastAddrCount attribute? | GC.S: P,M | Min value SHALL be 1(spec) |
| GC.S.A0003(UsedMcast AddrCount) | Does the device implement the UsedMcastAddrCount attribute? | GC.S: P,M | |
| GC.S.A0004(FabricUnde rTest) | Does the device implement the UsedMcastAddrCount attribute? | GC.S: P,M | |

## Commands received (Server)

| Variable | Description | Mandatory/Optional | Notes/Additional Constraints |
| GC.S.C00.Rsp(JoinGroup ) | Receiving the JoinGroup command? | GC.S: P,M | Adds or updates membership & key |
| GC.S.C01.Rsp(LeaveGro up) | Receiving the LeaveGroup command? | GC.S: P,M | Removes endpoints or entire membership |
| GC.S.C03.Rsp(UpdateGr oupKey) | Receiving the UpdateGroupKey command? | GC.S: P,M | Updates group KeySetID mapping |
| GC.S.C04.Rsp(Configure AuxiliaryACL) | Receiving the ConfigureAuxiliaryACL command? | P, GC.S.F00(LN) | Listener-only; sets HasAuxiliaryACL |
| GC.S.C05.Rsp(Groupcast Testing) | Receiving the GroupcastTesting command? | GC.S: P,M | Enables/disables test event generation |

## Commands generated (Server)

| Variable | Description | Mandatory/Optional | Notes/Additional Constraints |
| GC.S.C02.Tx(LeaveGrou pResponse) | Does the device implement sending the LeaveGroupResponse response? | GC.S: P,M | Sent in response to LeaveGroup |

## Events

| Variable | Description | Mandatory/Optional | Notes/Additional Constraints |

| GC.S.E00(GroupcastTest ing) | This event SHALL be generated during Groupcast testing processing after invocation of the GroupcastTesting command | GC.S: P,M |

## 111.2.1. Notes/Testing Considerations

- Placeholder value notation (symbol legend &amp; usage):
- G1..Gn = distinct valid, non 0, GroupID (uint16) values; G\_UNKNOWN = deliberately nonexistent; GroupID=0 is reserved as Leave all group with the LeaveGroup command.
- K1..Kn = distinct valid KeySetID values (uint16) within the fabric.
- EP1, EP2 = any two distinct, valid endpoints (uint16) on the DUT, excluding the Root endpoint and any aggregator endpoint.
- Keys: InputKey1..InputKeyn = distinct 128-bit (16-byte) key materials unless a step explicitly reuses or omits a key; length must be exactly 16 bytes for positive cases.
- M\_max = runtime value of MaxMembershipCount captured earlier via Store the value as. Per spec, for any single fabric the number of distinct GroupIDs joined SHALL be ⇐ floor(M\_max/2).

- A\_max = runtime value of MaxMcastAddrCount captured earlier via Store the value as.
- Substitution rule: Any concrete values may be substituted if they satisfy type, range, distinctness, and intentional-collision requirements implied by the step.
- For tests involving attribute reporting, the subscriber max interval tolerance should follow the subscription configuration in the test setup.

## TC-GC-2.2 JoinGroup as Listener or Sender with DUT as Server - PROVISIONAL

## Purpose

This test case verifies JoinGroup command creating a Listener or Sender membership entry with endpoints and key initialization.

## PICS

- GC.S

## Device Topology

TH and DUT are on the same fabric.

## Test Setup

Commission DUT to TH (can be skipped if done in a preceding test)

## Test Procedure

| # | Ref PICS | Test Step | Expected Outcome |

| 1d | TH reads OperationalCredentials cluster's CurrentFabricIndex attribute on Endpoint 0 | Verify DUT responds w/ status SUCCESS(0x00); value is stored as F1 |
| 2 | If LN feature is not supported on the cluster Skip to step 14 | |
| 3a | Attempt to join a Group G1 with a new key using the following configuration: TH sends command JoinGroup (GroupID=G1, Endpoints=[EP1], KeySetID=K1, Key=InputKey1) | Verify DUT responds w/ status SUCCESS(0x00) |
| 3c | TH reads from the DUT the Endpoint 0 AccessControl cluster AuxiliaryACL attribute | Verify DUT responds w/ status SUCCESS(0x00); value does not contain any entry or set of entries that logically represent or grant access on Endpoint EP1 to Group G1 for FabricIndex F1. |
| 4b | Attempt to add EP2 to Group G1. TH sends command JoinGroup (G1,[EP2],K1,Key omitted) | Verify DUT responds w/ status SUCCESS(0x00) |

| 5a | Attempt to replace endpoints for Group G1 using ReplaceEndpoints: TH sends command JoinGroup (GroupID=G1, Endpoints=[EP1], KeySetID=K1, Key omitted, ReplaceEndpoints=True) | Verify DUT responds w/ status SUCCESS(0x00) |
| 6a | Attempt to join a Group G2 with existing K1 and using UseAuxiliaryACL: TH sends command JoinGroup (GroupID=G2, Endpoints=[EP1], KeySetID=K1, Key omitted, UseAuxiliaryACL=True) | Verify DUT responds w/ status SUCCESS(0x00) |
| 6d | TH reads from the DUT the Endpoint 0 AccessControl cluster AuxiliaryACL attribute | Verify DUT responds w/ status SUCCESS(0x00); value contains entry or set of entries that logically represent and grant the Operate (3) privilege on Endpoint EP1 for Group G2 on FabricIndex F1. Each relevant entry SHALL have AuthMode=Group (3) and AuxiliaryType=Groupcast (1). |

| 7 | Attempt to join Group G3 using a new Key but providing an existing KeySetID: TH sends command JoinGroup (GroupID=G3, Endpoints=[EP1], KeySetID=K1, Key=InputKey2) | Verify DUT responds w/ status ALREADY_EXISTS(0xd0) |
| 8 | Attempt to join Group G3 using a new KeySetID but without providing the InputKey: TH sends command JoinGroup (GroupID=G3, Endpoints=[EP1], KeySetID=K2, Key omitted) | Verify DUT responds w/ status NOT_FOUND(0x8b) |
| 9 | Attempt to join Group G3 with invalid endpoint: TH sends command JoinGroup (GroupID=G3, Endpoints=[EP_INVALID], KeySetID=K1) | Verify DUT responds w/ status UNSUPPORTED_ENDPOINT(0x7f) |
| 10 | Attempt to join Group G3 with Root endpoint 0: TH sends command JoinGroup (GroupID=G3, Endpoints=[0], KeySetID=K1) | Verify DUT responds w/ status UNSUPPORTED_ENDPOINT(0x7f) |
| 11 | If SD feature is supported on the cluster Skip this step, else attempt to join Group G3 with an empty endpoints list: TH sends command JoinGroup (GroupID=G3, Endpoints=[], KeySetID=K1) | Verify DUT responds w/ status CONSTRAINT_ERROR(0x87) |
| 12 | If DUT has more than 20 endpoints, attempt to join Group G3 with 21 endpoints: TH sends command JoinGroup (GroupID=G3, Endpoints=[EP1..EP(21)], KeySetID=K1) | Verify DUT responds w/ status CONSTRAINT_ERROR(0x87) |
| 13 | If PGA feature is supported on the cluster Skip this step, else attempt to join Group G3 with McastAddrPolicy=PerGroup: TH sends command JoinGroup (GroupID=G3, Endpoints=[EP1], KeySetID=K1, McastAddrPolicy=PerGroup) | Verify DUT responds w/ status CONSTRAINT_ERROR(0x87) |
| 14 | If SD feature is not supported on the cluster Skip to step 20 | |

| 15a | Attempt to join Group G4 as Sender (no endpoints) and a new key: TH sends command JoinGroup (GroupID=G4, Endpoints=[], KeySetID=K2, Key=InputKey2) | Verify DUT responds w/ status SUCCESS(0x00) |
| 16a | Attempt to join Group G5 as Sender using an existing KeySetID: TH sends command JoinGroup (GroupID=G5, Endpoints=[], KeySetID=K2,Key omitted) | Verify DUT responds w/ status SUCCESS(0x00) |
| 17a | Attempt to join Group G5 using a new Key but providing an existing KeySetID: TH sends command JoinGroup (GroupID=G5, Endpoints=[], KeySetID=K2, Key=InputKey3) | Verify DUT responds w/ status ALREADY_EXISTS(0xd0) |
| 17b | Attempt to join Group G5 using a new KeySetID but without an InputKey: TH sends command JoinGroup (GroupID=G5, Endpoints=[], KeySetID=K3, Key omitted) | Verify DUT responds w/ status NOT_FOUND(0x8b) |
| 18 | If LN feature is supported on the cluster Skip this step, else attempt to use ReplaceEndpoints: TH sends command JoinGroup (GroupID=G5, Endpoints=[], KeySetID=K2, ReplaceEndpoints=True) | Verify DUT responds w/ status CONSTRAINT_ERROR(0x87) |

| 19 | If LN feature is supported on the cluster Skip this step, else attempt to use UseAuxiliaryACL: TH sends command JoinGroup (GroupID=G5, Endpoints=[], KeySetID=K2, UseAuxiliaryACL=True) | Verify DUT responds w/ status CONSTRAINT_ERROR(0x87) |
| 20 | TH sends command JoinGroup with invalid GroupID=0 | Verify DUT responds w/ status CONSTRAINT_ERROR(0x87) |
| 21 | TH sends command JoinGroup with Key length !=16 (e.g. 15 bytes) | Verify DUT responds w/ status CONSTRAINT_ERROR(0x87) |

## Notes

For LN related test steps, the specific endpoints used in the JoinGroup commands (e.g., EP1, EP2) can be any valid endpoints, excluding the Root endpoint and aggregator endpoints, available on the DUT. EP1 and EP2 notation represent two distinct endpoints.

The test implementations must always attempt to find an endpoint that is valid, based on the RootNode's parts list. Endpoint 0 must never appear in Endpoints arguments during testing.

## Notes

If only SD feature is supported on the cluster by the DUT, provide an empty list for the Endpoints field in all JoinGroup command steps.

If LN feature is supported on the cluster by the DUT, the endpoint list of the JoinGroup command is derived from the DUT's capabilities and represents the first valid endpoint excluding the Root endpoint and aggregator endpoints.

## TC-GC-2.8 GroupcastTesting command effect with DUT as Server - PROVISIONAL

## Purpose

This test case verifies GroupcastTesting enables/disables testing and updates FabricUnderTest.

## PICS

- GC.S

## Device Topology

TH and DUT are on the same fabric.

## Test Setup

Commission DUT to TH (can be skipped if done in a preceding test).

## Test Procedure

| # | Ref | PICS | Test Step | Expected Outcome |
| 1c | | | TH reads DUT Endpoint 0 OperationalCredentials cluster CurrentFabricIndex attribute | Verify DUT responds w/ status SUCCESS(0x00); value is stored as F1 |
| 2 | | | TH reads from the DUT the FabricUnderTest attribute | Verify DUT responds w/ status SUCCESS(0x00); value == 0 |
| 3 | | | Enable a test operation: TH sends command GroupcastTesting (TestOperation="see notes") | Verify DUT responds w/ status SUCCESS(0x00) |
| 4 | | | TH awaits subscription report of new FabricUnderTest attribute | Verify DUT responds w/ status SUCCESS(0x00); value == F1 |
| 5 | | | Disable testing: TH sends command GroupcastTesting (TestOperation=DisableTesting) | Verify DUT responds w/ status SUCCESS(0x00) |
| 6 | | | TH awaits subscription report of new FabricUnderTest attribute | Verify DUT responds w/ status SUCCESS(0x00); value == 0 |
| 7 | | | Enable a test operation for 10 seconds: TH sends command GroupcastTesting (TestOperation="see notes", DurationSeconds=10) | Verify DUT responds w/ status SUCCESS(0x00) |
| 8 | | | TH awaits subscription report of new FabricUnderTest attribute | Verify DUT responds w/ status SUCCESS(0x00); value == F1 |
| 9 | | | TH awaits subscription report of new FabricUnderTest attribute after DurationSeconds of step 7 has elapsed | Verify DUT responds w/ status SUCCESS(0x00); value == 0 |

## Notes

If LN feature is supported on the cluster by the DUT, use TestOperation=EnableListenerTesting, Else SD shall be supported by the DUT, use TestOperation=EnableSenderTesting.
